market_data.name: Yahoo Finance Chart API
market_data.purpose: Real delayed current quote metadata and intraday OHLC candles for NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, MSFT, SOXL, SPY.
market_data.notes: No API key. Responses are proxied by the backend; frontend never calls Yahoo directly. This feed is delayed/last-sale and is not presented as no-delay real-time equity data. Yahoo does not provide 30s candles through this public endpoint.

market_data.name: Coinbase Exchange Product Ticker
market_data.purpose: Real-time BTC-USD and ETH-USD ticker price, bid, ask, last trade id, size, and trade time.
market_data.notes: Used for live crypto REST snapshots.

market_data.name: Coinbase Exchange WebSocket Ticker
market_data.purpose: Tick-by-tick BTC-USD and ETH-USD stream proxied through the FastAPI backend.
market_data.notes: Browser connects only to the backend websocket. 30s active crypto candles are built from this real tick stream after page load.

market_data.name: Coinbase Exchange Product Stats
market_data.purpose: Real BTC-USD and ETH-USD 24-hour open, high, low, and volume.
market_data.notes: Used to calculate live crypto 24-hour change.

market_data.name: Coinbase Exchange Product Candles
market_data.purpose: Real BTC-USD and ETH-USD OHLC candles for 1m, 5m, 15m, and 1h; 2m is aggregated server-side from real 1m candles.
market_data.notes: Coinbase REST does not publish 30s candle history. For 30s, the backend returns native 1m history plus metadata, and the frontend only advances the active 30s candle from backend-proxied Coinbase WebSocket ticks.

market_data.name: Coinbase Exchange Product Book
market_data.purpose: Real crypto order book depth for BTC-USD and ETH-USD.
market_data.notes: Used only for crypto symbols supported by Coinbase.

market_data.name: Coinbase Exchange Product Trades
market_data.purpose: Real recent trade tape for BTC-USD and ETH-USD.
market_data.notes: Used only for crypto symbols supported by Coinbase.
